$comment: IDD in-session enforcement — GitHub Copilot hooks (CLI, cloud coding agent, VS Code agent mode; installed as .github/hooks/idd.json). Same two enforcement points as the Claude Code template: postToolUse runs the committed ast-grep checks against each edited file, and preToolUse is the commit gate — the same checks over the tree, denying `git commit` on failure. Copilot's exit-code semantics invert Claude Code's (exit 2 warns and continues), so these hooks never signal by exit code: the gate denies via stdout `permissionDecision` JSON, the edit check feeds back via `additionalContext`, and both always exit 0. Scripts probe both payload spellings (toolName/toolArgs and tool_name/tool_input) and filter tools in-script because VS Code ignores matcher config. Deterministic and local: no LLM, no network, no CI, no git hooks. Silent no-op when jq or ast-grep is missing or no checks are committed, so adopting IDD never breaks a repo.

postToolUse.bash:
p=$(cat); command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; command -v ast-grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ls .github/idd/checks/*.yml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; t=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.toolName // .tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$t" in edit|create|str_replace_editor|apply_patch|Edit|Write) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; f=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.toolArgs.path // .toolArgs.filePath // .toolArgs.file_path // .tool_input.path // .tool_input.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; out=$(ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml "$f" 2>&1) || { ctx=$(printf 'IDD mechanical check failed — fix before proposing this diff:
%s
' "$out" | jq -Rs .); printf '{"additionalContext":%s}
' "$ctx"; }; exit 0

preToolUse.bash:
p=$(cat); command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; command -v ast-grep >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; ls .github/idd/checks/*.yml >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; t=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.toolName // .tool_name // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$t" in bash|powershell|Bash) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cmd=$(printf '%s' "$p" | jq -r '.toolArgs.command // .tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$cmd" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; out=$(ast-grep scan --config sgconfig.yml 2>&1) || { r=$(printf 'IDD commit gate: mechanical checks failed — fix before committing:
%s
' "$out" | jq -Rs .); printf '{"permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":%s}
' "$r"; }; exit 0
